smartphone.definition: A mobile phone with more advanced computing capability and connectivity than basic feature phones.

smartwatch.definition: A wrist-worn digital device that tells time and performs computer tasks through wireless connections.

wireless-earbuds.definition: Small earphones that connect to a device wirelessly, usually by Bluetooth.
wireless-earbuds.exampleUsage: The wireless earbuds connected to the tablet.

e-reader.definition: A portable electronic device designed mainly for reading digital books and documents.
e-reader.exampleUsage: She downloaded a library book to the e-reader.

portable-charger.definition: A rechargeable battery pack used to supply power to electronic devices away from an outlet.
portable-charger.exampleUsage: The portable charger powered the phone during the trip.

usb-c-hub.definition: A device that connects to a USB-C port and provides several additional ports or connections.
usb-c-hub.exampleUsage: The USB-C hub added an HDMI port and card reader.

stylus.definition: A pen-shaped tool used to write or draw on a touch screen.

webcam.definition: A small camera that sends live video to a computer.

smart-speaker.definition: An internet-connected speaker that can play audio and respond to voice commands.
smart-speaker.exampleUsage: The smart speaker set a timer.

smart-display.definition: A network-connected screen with smart-assistant features for information, video, and device control.
smart-display.exampleUsage: The smart display showed the calendar and weather.

smart-thermostat.definition: An internet-linked control device adjusts a building's heating, cooling, and airflow according to settings, household routines, and conditions such as outdoor temperature.

smart-lock.definition: An electronic lock that can be controlled or monitored digitally.
smart-lock.exampleUsage: The smart lock recorded when the door was unlocked.

robot-vacuum.definition: An autonomous floor-cleaning device that moves around a room and collects dust or debris.
robot-vacuum.exampleUsage: The robot vacuum returned to its charging dock.

smart-bulb.definition: A light bulb that can be controlled electronically through an app, voice assistant, or other system.
smart-bulb.exampleUsage: The smart bulb dimmed automatically in the evening.

security-camera.definition: A camera used to monitor or record an area for safety and security.
security-camera.exampleUsage: The security camera covers the entrance.

smart-plug.definition: A network-connected plug or adapter that lets electrical power to a device be controlled electronically.
smart-plug.exampleUsage: The smart plug turns the lamp off on a schedule.

video-doorbell.definition: A doorbell with a camera, microphone, and network connection that lets residents view or communicate with visitors.
video-doorbell.exampleUsage: The video doorbell sent a notification when someone arrived.

smart-scale.definition: A digital scale that can record or send measurement data to an app or connected service.
smart-scale.exampleUsage: The smart scale saved the measurement to the user's account.

fitness-tracker.definition: A wearable device that records activity information such as steps, movement, or exercise time.
fitness-tracker.exampleUsage: The fitness tracker counted steps during the walk.

vr-headset.definition: A head-worn display that presents a computer-generated virtual environment to the user's eyes.
vr-headset.exampleUsage: The VR headset displayed a virtual museum.

ar-glasses.definition: Glasses that overlay digital information or images onto a view of the real world.
ar-glasses.exampleUsage: The AR glasses displayed directions over the user's view.

smart-ring.definition: A small wearable electronic ring that can contain sensors and connect to a phone or other device.
smart-ring.exampleUsage: The smart ring synchronized activity data with the app.

health-monitor.definition: A device or system that tracks selected health-related measurements; consumer devices are not a substitute for professional diagnosis.
health-monitor.exampleUsage: The health monitor recorded a measurement for the user to review.

gps-watch.definition: A wristwatch with satellite-positioning features for tracking location, routes, or outdoor activity.
gps-watch.exampleUsage: The GPS watch recorded the route during the walk.

action-camera.definition: A small durable camera designed to record wide-angle video during travel, sports, or other activities.
action-camera.exampleUsage: The action camera recorded the bicycle route.

body-camera.definition: A small wearable camera designed to record events from the wearer's viewpoint.
body-camera.exampleUsage: The training officer checked the body camera before the shift.

sleep-tracker.definition: A device or app that estimates sleep patterns using sensors or user data; it does not provide a medical diagnosis.
sleep-tracker.exampleUsage: The sleep tracker estimated the length of the night's sleep.

posture-corrector.definition: A wearable support marketed to encourage a more upright posture; it should not replace medical assessment of persistent pain or posture problems.
posture-corrector.exampleUsage: The product information describes the posture corrector as a support rather than a medical cure.

mechanical-keyboard.definition: A computer keyboard in which each key uses an individual mechanical switch.
mechanical-keyboard.exampleUsage: The mechanical keyboard has separate switches under the keys.

ergonomic-mouse.definition: A computer mouse shaped to reduce awkward hand or wrist positions during use.
ergonomic-mouse.exampleUsage: The ergonomic mouse has a shape that supports the hand.

monitor.definition: Display produced by a device that takes signals and displays them on a television screen or a computer monitor.

docking-station.definition: A device that connects a laptop to several accessories at once.

external-ssd.definition: A portable solid-state storage drive that connects externally to a computer or device.
external-ssd.exampleUsage: The external SSD stored a backup copy of the project.

webcam-light.definition: A light positioned near a webcam to improve illumination for video calls or recordings.
webcam-light.exampleUsage: The webcam light made the speaker's face easier to see.

microphone.definition: A device that changes sound into an electrical recording or signal.

green-screen.definition: A green background used to add different images during editing.

standing-desk-mat.definition: A cushioned mat designed for standing on while using a standing desk.
standing-desk-mat.exampleUsage: The standing-desk mat provided a softer surface underfoot.

cable-organizer.definition: A clip, sleeve, tray, or other item used to keep cables arranged and reduce tangles.
cable-organizer.exampleUsage: The cable organizer kept the charging cords together.
